verdicts.reason: A: the white card covers nearly the whole canvas, so the desert dunes and sun are gone and only orange slivers show at the corners. Copy sits about 12px from the left edge and the subline leaves 'June.' orphaned, but the headline, logo and CTA are clear and well grouped in a sensible left-to-right banner. B: keeps the dunes, but the card is cut off at the top and bottom canvas edges, the centred logo doesn't share an axis with the left-aligned copy, and the 'See Fares' CTA has shrunk to an illegible pill, burying the action.
